question.text: The number of solutions of $\sin ^2 x+\left(2+2 x-x^2\right) \sin x-3(x-1)^2=0$, where $-\pi \leq x \leq \pi$, is________

solution.text:
$\sin ^2 x-\left(x^2-2 x-2\right) \sin x-3(x-1)^2=0$
$\begin{aligned} & \sin x=-3(\text { reject }) \text { or }(x-1)^2 \\ & \sin x=(x-1)^2\end{aligned}$
